slot_scores.name: unclear_overtime_minimization_goal
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked how to handle the dual objectives of maximizing profit and minimizing overtime. It treated overtime only as a cost deducted from profit, which is one of the listed failure modes.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Overtime minimization is handled solely by deducting the 100 yuan/hour overtime cost from profit, rather than being treated as a separate objective to balance against profit maximization.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked how to reconcile the two stated objectives (maximize profit, minimize overtime). It assumed a single-objective profit formulation with overtime as a cost, without confirmation.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P0 hidden slot H1 (how to handle the profit-maximization vs. overtime-minimization multi-objective trade-off) remained completely unaddressed.

summary: The agent thoroughly clarified overtime mechanics, integrality, and placeholder handling, but completely missed the P0 multi-objective issue of balancing profit maximization against overtime minimization, silently collapsing it into a single-objective profit model with overtime as a cost.

restoration_summary.rule: Core exact uses P0/P1 only; all-slot exact uses P0/P1/P2. P2-only cases are not applicable to core exact.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
